module_role: Wire-level + device-framework serial bus specification. Defines the protocol between a Host Controller and any number of compliant USB devices connected through a tiered-star hub topology. Host-Controller hardware-register interface (OHCI / UHCI / EHCI) is NOT part of USB 2.0 — covered by separate specs.
topology_description: Tiered star centered on the Host Controller. Tier 1 = Root Hub. Up to 5 tiers of hubs may be cascaded; total ≤ 127 devices (including hubs themselves).

integration_overview.host_side_register_spec: Separate (OHCI / UHCI / EHCI / xHCI) — not in USB 2.0 itself.
integration_overview.device_side_interface: Endpoints + descriptors defined by USB 2.0 + class specs (HID, MSC, CDC, Audio, Video, etc.).
integration_overview.VBUS_polarity: Host or hub supplies +5 V to device.
integration_overview.power_classes: bus-powered (≤ 100 mA pre-config / ≤ 500 mA configured) or self-powered (≤ 100 mA from VBUS for enumeration).

interface_categories: Hub (1 USB Root Hub + up to 5 tiers of external hubs)
Function (USB device providing capability — keyboard, MSC, camera, etc.)
Compound device (multiple functions on one physical device)
Transaction Translator (TT) inside USB 2.0 hub bridging HS upstream to FS/LS downstream
interconnect_topologies_supported: Single host + N functions through a single root port (point-to-point in tier 2).
default_signal_values_when_omitted: Bus idle = J-state on D+/D- (FS+LS) or transmitter-off squelched state (HS).
soc_dependent_items: Choice of Host Controller IP (OHCI / UHCI / EHCI / xHCI).
USB PHY transceiver implementation (analog: differential drivers + receivers + envelope detector + squelch detector + chirp generator).
VBUS source / regulation / current-limit per port.
Interrupt routing for transfer-complete / port-change / SOF events.
DMA-controller wiring for high-throughput Bulk + Isochronous transfers.
Crystal / PLL providing the 480 MHz (HS) or 48 MHz (FS) clock with ≤ 500 ppm tolerance.

low_power_modes.Suspend: Bus idle > 3 ms; device draws ≤ 500 µA from VBUS
low_power_modes.Selective_suspend: Host suspends specific downstream port; rest of bus continues
low_power_modes.Remote_wakeup: Device drives K-state to upstream port to wake the bus

device_classes_examples: HID (Human Interface Device) — keyboard, mouse, joystick
MSC (Mass Storage Class) — USB flash drive, external HDD
